name: Athlete
summary: +1 Str or Dex; Climb Speed equal to your Speed, stand up for 5 feet of movement, and jump after a 5-foot run.

benefits.name: Climb Speed
benefits.summary: Gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
benefits.text: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

benefits.name: Hop Up
benefits.summary: Standing up from Prone costs only 5 feet of movement.
benefits.text: When you have the Prone condition, you can right yourself using only 5 feet of movement.

benefits.name: Jumping
benefits.summary: Make a running Long Jump or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.
benefits.text: You can make a running Long Jump or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.
